description: A SolveSpace file 'divider.slvs' is already open in the application. This is a real parametric part file from the official SolveSpace tutorial (a wooden box divider panel, which may include 2D sketches and 3D extrude groups). Export the 2D sketch view of this part to DXF format using File > Export 2d View... from the menu bar. In the export file dialog, change the format dropdown (at the bottom of the dialog) from the default PDF to 'DXF file (AutoCAD 2007) (*.dxf)'. Then navigate to the '/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/' directory and save the file as 'divider.dxf'. DXF (Drawing Exchange Format) is a standard CAD interchange format used for sharing vector drawings between different CAD applications.
